utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, I heard the repair drive plan is to collect broken small appliances and tools first, then line up repair volunteers—but the exact time and bring-list are still being figured out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s right, Vik — I’m making the sign-up sheet now so we can confirm what folks are bringing before we lock the time and volunteer list. If you hear of specific appliances or tools, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Rosa—I’ll tell folks to send specific appliances and tools my way, and I’ll pass the details on to you for the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Pia. I’ve got next Saturday at Sam’s garage in mind, and I’d like us to keep the list to lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture repairs unless there’s something urgent already reported.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds workable, Eli, but before we put it out there, can we confirm the exact drop-off window, who’s covering each shift, and where finished or waiting items will be stored?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, let’s make it plain: drop-off from 9 to 11, two short shifts to cover the table, and we’ll ask Sam and Opal to mark separate spots for finished and waiting items.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I told Dane I can sort parts or carry things, so I’ll be near the boxes when the drive starts. I’m keeping it quiet, but I do want to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s really kind, Uli—I won’t make a fuss about it. I’m hoping to help too, maybe with the list or pointing people toward Rosa and Jules.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. If you’re near the list, maybe just point me to whatever pile needs hands and I’ll keep to that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Kira—if I’ve got this straight, today we’re collecting working hand tools for the repair drive, and I’m bringing my spare hammer and a couple screwdrivers over to Opal.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds helpful, Oren, but can you confirm Opal is definitely the drop-off spot today and that someone will be there to receive them?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I believe Opal’s the one noting who drops off what today, but let me double-check before I haul the tools over—my memory’s not exactly a steel trap.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, we’re prioritizing safety repairs first: leaky roofs, broken steps, and heating issues. Can you help spot any homes that need one of those?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can ask around quietly and make a short list of any roofs, steps, or heating trouble I hear about, then bring it back before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey. Just note the address, issue, and how urgent it sounds—no promises yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira! We’re aiming to get a few handy fixers and a triage helper lined up first, likely late morning so folks like Faye can pitch in around school schedules.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—that helps. I’ll pass along that the focus is lining up fixers and a triage helper for late morning, and I’ll keep listening for any safety-repair updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’d be great. If you hear of any safety-repair needs or someone good for triage, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I’m bringing screwdrivers, pliers, the drill, spare fasteners, tape, and some clamps for the repair drive, and I’ll come a little early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus, that’s a huge help — I’ll let Cleo know those supplies are offered, and I’ll mark you down for early setup once we’ve pinned down the date and location.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara—just send me the date and spot once they’re set, and I’ll have everything packed and ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mina, I’m keeping the repair-drive supply list provisional for now—do you know of any tools, tape, screws, or spare parts we can confirm are already on hand?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus can bring a couple labeled toolboxes and a cordless drill, and I asked him for extra drill bits. Cleo, can you mark those as confirmed and keep screws, tape, and spare parts as still needed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ll mark Gus’s labeled toolboxes and cordless drill as confirmed, with extra drill bits pending, and keep screws, tape, and spare parts on the needed list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Tess, I’m tracking repair drive details today—tools are being collected, and I’ve tentatively marked the drop-off table by the community room entrance and the tool station near the back wall.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Opal, that’s helpful—I’ll tell folks tools are being collected, but I’ll keep the table spots as tentative unless you want me spreading those too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please keep the locations tentative for now, Tess—just tell folks to bring working hand tools today, and I’ll update you once Bo confirms the table spots.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Quinn—honestly, I’m still a bit behind on the repair drive details; last I heard they hadn’t nailed down the time or the bring-list yet, but I’m asking around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah—that helps. I’ll tell folks the basics for now and ask them to hold their wobbly chairs, torn jackets, lamps, bikes, and such until we’ve got the time confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds perfect, Quinn—thanks for helping keep it from getting muddled. I’ll check with a couple folks and pass along the confirmed time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Faye — the repair drive is shaping up for next Saturday at my garage, with lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture repairs on the list. I’m sorting tools and making the sign-up sheet now, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great, Sam — I’ll ask around at school pickup and see who might be handy. Once you know the time slots, send them my way and I’ll figure out where I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — I’ll draft the time slots on the sign-up sheet and send them over once they’re set. Appreciate you asking around at school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana—I’m still catching up, but the plan seems to be collecting broken small appliances and tools first, then matching them with repair volunteers. I’m also trying to pull together a quick needs list so folks know what supplies matter most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—that helps, but I want to double-check before we announce anything: are roof leaks and front steps still the first priority, or has the drive shifted to appliances and tools?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good catch, Hana—I don’t want to overstate it. I’ve only heard the repair drive framed around appliances and tools so far, so let’s hold off announcing any shift until we confirm whether roof leaks and front steps are still the priority.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Mara, I’m glad I found you — the repair drive is definitely happening, but I’m checking the noticeboard for the confirmed time before I go telling everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — please let me know what time you find on the noticeboard, and I’ll hold off sharing details until we’ve got that confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Mara — I’ll check the noticeboard first and come straight back to you with the confirmed time before either of us spreads it around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Jules, quick version I’ve got is Saturday at the community room for small broken household stuff—I'm spreading the word and might bring my busted toaster.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Bo—small household fixes are exactly the idea, and your toaster can be our test case. If you know any handy folks or someone organized who can help triage, send them my way for the late-morning stretch.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do—I’ll nudge a couple handy neighbors and anyone organized I can think of for late morning, but I’ll tell them to check in with you for the real details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m still catching up while I’m out—have you heard any confirmed updates on the repair drive priorities?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not confirmed, Ira — Rosa said she’d gather a sign-up sheet for what people need fixed, and Tess was checking the noticeboard for the time before anyone spreads details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira—that helps. I’ll hold off on repeating anything as confirmed until Rosa’s sign-up sheet and Tess’s noticeboard time are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, I’m still trying to pin down the repair drive timing around school pickup—have you heard whether they’re aiming for late morning or after school?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I haven’t heard a firm time yet, but after school may work better for families. I’ll check with Ira and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — after school would be easiest on my end, but I can make late morning work if that’s where they land.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Pia — I’m sorting the tools and making the sign-up sheet, and it looks like we’re aiming for next Saturday with my garage as the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a good start — before we announce it, can we confirm the drop-off times, volunteer coverage, and where everything will be stored?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the hours and storage setup today, and I can add volunteer time slots to the sign-up sheet so we know we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Vik, yes—the repair drive is on today, and I’m supposed to bring my spare hammer and a couple screwdrivers to Opal for the tool collection before I forget.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Oren—I’ll pass along that it’s happening today and that tools like a hammer and screwdrivers should go to Opal for the collection.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—yes, Opal’s keeping track of who brings what. If you see me wandering off, remind me to actually drop those tools off!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m still catching up, but the plan so far is to collect broken small appliances and tools first, note basic supply needs like screws and tape, then match repairs with volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. Let’s write that down plainly: next Saturday at Sam’s garage, small appliances and tools first, supplies listed as they come in, then volunteers matched to each repair.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, Eli—I’ll pass it around just like that and make sure Uli has a quiet sorting or carrying job if they still want one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I’m bringing screwdrivers, pliers, the drill, extra bits, tape, and a few clamps for the repair drive—and I’ll label my boxes and come early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really useful, Gus—Rosa’s still making the list, and Jules is matching handy folks up, so I’ll pass along that you’re bringing tools and can help set up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell—just have Rosa or Jules holler if the list turns up anything else, and I’ll make room in the truck.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, before we make any plans, can you confirm what you’ve heard about the repair drive—especially the date, location, urgent repairs, and who’s actually available to help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, Hana, I can’t confirm all that yet—I only heard they were still sorting out the exact time and what people should bring. I said I’d ask around, so I’ll check on the date, location, urgent repairs, and helpers before we plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—please check those details first, and I’ll hold off on setting anything until we know what’s actually confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Quinn, I’m keeping the repair drive supply list provisional for now—do you know of any confirmed tools, tape, spare parts, or basics we already have?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Confirmed so far, I only know we’ve got interest and a few repair needs—Marla’s toaster, Mr. Iqbal’s lamp, plus likely chairs, jackets, bikes—but I haven’t heard any definite tools or supplies yet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—that’s still useful, I’ll log those repair needs separately and keep tools and supplies marked unconfirmed until someone verifies them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Opal, I’m still piecing it together, but it sounds like gutters and porch railings are first. Do you know if anyone’s settled where the tables or sign-up sheet should go?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not settled yet, Rey—I have the community center noted as the next location, but Bo hasn’t confirmed the drop-off table or tool station spot. I’ll mark gutters and porch railings as first priorities and keep the sign-up sheet location pending.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal—that helps. I’ll hold off on telling folks a table spot until Bo confirms, and I’ll just say gutters and railings are the first focus for now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m going to help a little with the repair drive, mostly sorting parts near the boxes. I’m keeping quiet today, but I can still be useful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli—that would be a big help. I’ll set you up near the labeled boxes so you can sort quietly and just wave me over if anything’s unclear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. That sounds good—I’ll stay by the labeled boxes and wave if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mara, before we announce the repair drive, can we confirm the drop-off hours, the volunteer shifts, and where we’ll keep items if it rains?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, let’s hold off announcing until we settle those—nothing’s confirmed yet, so I’ll help pin down hours, shifts, and a rain storage spot alongside the date and location.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Mara—that makes me feel better. Once we have those pieces written down, I’ll be comfortable sharing it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing it together, Vik, but it sounds like tools and table space are the first things to sort out. Do you know anyone who’d be willing to handle sign-ups?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can ask around and point folks your way—last I heard we’re collecting broken appliances and tools first, with the exact time and bring-list still not settled.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik—that helps. If you hear who’s comfortable doing sign-ups, send them my way, and I’ll keep checking on table space and spare supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Jules, before we make any plans, can you tell me what’s confirmed so far for the repair drive and whether Ken or any other Saturday volunteers are definite?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So far it’s this weekend with small broken items welcome, and Mara’s looking for handy fixers plus someone organized for triage; I don’t have Ken or any Saturday volunteers confirmed yet, but I’m checking who can commit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—please let me know as soon as you confirm the Saturday volunteers, and I’ll hold off counting Ken until we hear directly. I’ll note small broken items and triage as tentative for now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Bo, I’m glad I ran into you — I know the repair drive is happening, but I’m checking the noticeboard for the confirmed time before I tell folks when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only skimmed it, Tess, but I think it’s this Saturday in the community room—better trust the noticeboard for the exact time before spreading it around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Bo — Saturday in the community room is helpful, but I’ll check the noticeboard for the exact time before I start telling everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, thanks for bringing the labeled toolboxes and extra bits. What time can you drop them off Saturday, and can you stay to help with roof leaks or broken steps?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can drop them off around 8:30 Saturday, labeled and packed with the extra bits. I’ll stick around after that and help wherever you need me, roof leaks or steps included.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, come at 8:30 and start with the broken steps unless the roof crew is short; can you bring work gloves and a ladder if you have one?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! I’m coordinating the repair drive for Saturday at the community room—we’re gathering small broken items and matching them with neighbors who can help fix them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa, got it—I'll mark Saturday at the community room as the repair drive location and note that we're gathering small broken items for neighbor repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that’s perfect. Could you also note that porch rails, broken lights, garden tools, and small household items are the main things we’ve heard about so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m going to help a little with the repair drive, mostly sorting parts near the boxes. I’m keeping it quiet today, if that’s alright.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s alright, Uli—quiet help still helps. I’m a bit fuzzy on the latest plan myself, but sorting parts near the boxes sounds useful.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll keep to the boxes and wait for Dane to point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I’m glad I caught you—there’s a repair drive coming together for small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes, and I’m making sure folks hear fast.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn—I’d heard mostly about the safety repairs, so that’s helpful. I’ll pass along that the drive is also covering small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thank you—Ira, if you run into Marla or Mr. Iqbal, please nudge them too, since I heard they’ve got a toaster and a lamp waiting for help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Sam—today’s the tool collection for the repair drive, if I’m remembering right. I’m bringing my spare hammer and a couple screwdrivers over before they slip my mind.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — yes, bring them by my garage whenever you can, and I’ll add them to the tool pile I’m sorting for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam—I’ll head over with the hammer and screwdrivers now, before I set them down somewhere silly. If Opal’s keeping the list, I’ll make sure she knows they came from me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Faye, I’m keeping the repair drive supply list provisional for now—do you know of any confirmed tools or basics we already have on hand?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t seen a confirmed list yet, Cleo, but I can ask around after school pickup and send you anything solid so you’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye—that’s perfect. I’ll keep your notes marked unconfirmed until you’ve got something solid, especially for basics like tape, gloves, screws, and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Leo, before we tell anyone more, can you confirm the repair drive date, drop-off times, and who’s handling storage?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Date’s Saturday the 18th, drop-off is 9 to 11 at the community room, and I’ll handle storage unless Sam’s sheet changes anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Leo — can you double-check Sam’s sheet today and let me know if anything changes before I pass that along?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
